text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the hectic preparations for the 
Goshiki Shuntaisai, 
I arrived in a certain town alongside No 
Reason.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mwahaha. This town originated from a 
settlement built together 
by Umamusume and humans during the Sengoku 
era, you see.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It overflows with historical sites and 
tales that speak to the deep bonds between 
Umamusume and mankind. 
Allow me to be your guide as we embark on 
a journey of discovery!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, this area was once home to the horse 
couriers! 
Behold, behind it they even recreated the 
field where they grew the carrots for 
their packed lunches!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Gaze upon that hollowed basin. That is a 
remnant of how townspeople in the Sengoku 
era settled disputes through races.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In an era without modern rules, races 
raged from dawn till dusk. 
It is said the trampling hooves of the 
Umamusume carved into the earth, gradually 
sculpting that very valley.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
............ 
Though naturally, that part was entirely a 
tall tale of mine.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Fret not, for the next 
destination I shall show you is truly 
historic, so look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A shrine perched atop a hill overlooking 
the town. 
'Tis said it was built hand in hand by 
Umamusume and humans to pray for peace 
across these lands!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
An indispensable location when 
contemplating the bond between Umamusume 
and humankind. 
We must pay our respects at least once!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nani-i-i-gh?! Wh-What in blazes is this?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though the main hall of the shrine barely 
remains standing, 
there is no sign of people—it is visibly 
dilapidated and run-down.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?! Are you here to worship?! 
Th-That's rare...
choice_data_list:
Isn't this supposed to be a historic 
shrine...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Ah, w-well... It's true that in the old 
days, it was sort of the heart of the 
community— 
they even used to hold festivals here and 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
But over the last few decades, it's fallen 
into decline... 
Right now, it's pretty much forgotten by 
the locals... practically on the verge of 
disappearing entirely.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
...Well, times change, I suppose. 
Maybe we just have to accept it, but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Nay! I refuse to accept this! 
What of the historical romance that 
ignited my very soul?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
O Shrine Maiden. Tell me— 
hast thou no ambition?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text: Am... Ambition?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! The desire to reclaim its former 
glory! 
The burning will to remind the world of 
the sentiments poured into this sanctuary! 
Such ambition!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, sure, I'd like that, but... 
Realistically speaking, it's just 
impossible—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nay, it is entirely "possible"! Today!! 
Upon this very ground!! 
For I and my strategist have arrived upon 
the scene!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Though I may look modest, I am an 
Umamusume whose name echoes through the 
turbulent warring states of racing! 
Acclaimed by many as "The General Closest 
to Unifying the Realm"!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And this Trainer is a master strategist 
renowned under heaven! 
Whether upon the turf or beyond, none can 
rival their intellect—hailed by all as the 
modern Zhuge Liang... nay, the 
"Transcendent Kongming"!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Priest
text_block_list.text:
Y-You two are people of such incredible 
stature...! 
F-Forgive my lack of reverence...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
This land was once the beating heart of 
the whole region. 
Blessed with immense geographical 
advantage! 
It has every chance of reclaiming its 
former glory!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, what say you? Wilt thou 
entrust 
the fate of this shrine unto me?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Priest
text_block_list.text: A-As... As you command...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha! Put thy heart at ease, as if 
boarding a grand galleon!

title: Crossing Paths as Swiftly as the Wind
